name: seo-meta
description: Skill for pulling SEO tags from any URL — title, meta description, OG tags, canonical, H1s, robots — so the model can audit how a page presents itself to search engines and social scrapers.

descriptions.en: Skill for pulling SEO tags from any URL — title, meta description, OG tags, canonical, H1s, robots — so the model can audit how a page presents itself to search engines and social scrapers.
descriptions.zh-CN: 提取网页标题、描述、分享标签、规范链接与搜索引擎相关元数据。
